baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause joining the messenger's coming to turning the speakers away from their gods.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers make arrival the cause of a forced directional change and cast their cultic objects as the defended orientation. The question is therefore a causal accusation, not a neutral request for the reason behind the visit.

activation_trace.role: Coming supplies the initiating approach from which the alleged intervention begins.
Deflection supplies the directional operation and makes persuasion sound like forced reorientation.
Objects constituted by worship supply the orientation the speakers claim to defend.

changed_reading.before: They ask why the messenger has come and refuse his teaching.
changed_reading.after: They diagnose his very coming as an attempt to wrench them out of an established worship-direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to bring what is threatened, followed by the condition of being among the truthful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative turns a verbal threat into something they demand as a present deliverable. The truth condition then equates truthful speech with enacted fulfillment, converting the warning into a proposed empirical test controlled by the challengers.

activation_trace.role: Giving or producing something makes the threatened content function as a demanded delivery.
The arrival of calamity keeps the demanded object anchored specifically as harmful fulfillment.
Threatening speech supplies the adverse future content whose arrival is demanded.
Truth as fulfillment in action makes occurrence, rather than assertion alone, their chosen test.

changed_reading.before: They issue a generic taunt to produce the punishment.
changed_reading.after: They propose an adversarial verification rule: the warning counts as true only when the speaker makes it happen before them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from their opening speech-act and accusation of compulsion to their own command to bring the warning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their utterance behaves as counter-negotiation. They accuse the visitor of coercing their orientation, then answer with an imperative meant to compel him to produce the event on their timetable; disputed control is mirrored across the two halves.

activation_trace.role: Speech as negotiation frames the verse as a bid to reset terms rather than mere description.
Compelled movement intensifies how they characterize the messenger's intended effect on them.
Producing and presenting a thing supplies the counter-command by which they try to control the encounter.
The scheduling dimension of a promised event exposes the challengers' attempt to seize its timing.

changed_reading.before: The two clauses are separate objections: do not change our worship, and prove your warning.
changed_reading.after: Both clauses contest agency: they call his invitation coercive while trying to coerce the warning into their chosen moment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demand repeats the earlier form 'bring me X, if you are truthful' but swaps a book or residue of knowledge for the threatened event. That substitution revises the demanded-enactment baseline: the reply appropriates an evidentiary challenge while quietly changing a producible proof request into a demand that the messenger control punishment.

activation_trace.role: In the focus, production and presentation govern the demanded warning.
Earlier production and presentation govern a requested documentary or knowledge-bearing proof, supplying the syntactic echo.
Truthful speech closes the earlier challenge with the same conditional test used in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:4 and 46:22 share an imperative of bringing, an object, and a conditional truth formula.
The earlier object is a book or surviving trace of knowledge; the focus substitutes the threatened event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the close formula and the contrasting objects. I infer that the speakers echo and repurpose the earlier burden of proof, with the arrow from document to catastrophe exposing a category shift. A live alternative is that both verses independently use a conventional challenge formula.

changed_reading.before: Their demand is an isolated dare for punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their demand is a mimetic counter-challenge that borrows the messenger's proof syntax while changing what one party can reasonably be asked to bring.

context_deltas.mechanism: When truth comes, the rejecters label it magic; after failing to be guided by it, they call it an old falsehood. Against that sequence, the focus accusation that the messenger is turning them away becomes projective: their speech assigns diversion to him while their labels perform a diversion from the arriving claim.

activation_trace.role: The focus assigns the act of directional deflection to the messenger.
The coming of the truth supplies the incoming claim that is immediately reclassified as magic.
Falsehood displaced from truth supplies the rejecters' own dismissive label after non-guidance.

structural_cues: 46:7 orders arrival of truth before the label of magic.
46:11 orders failure to be guided before the label of old falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hostile relabeling around an arriving truth and the same focus root. I infer a projective reversal from their own deflective speech to their accusation against the messenger. A live alternative is simple thematic repetition without deliberate psychological projection.

changed_reading.before: They fear being diverted from their gods.
changed_reading.after: Their accusation itself participates in diversion by redescribing the arriving truth as deception and placing the turning on the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly joins promise with truth, then stages another skeptic who rejects a promised emergence because generations have already passed. This revises the focus truth test: non-immediacy is shown to be the challenger's premise, not evidence that the promise lacks truth.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the adverse promise whose truth is challenged through demanded immediacy.
A promise that opens expectation is explicitly paired with truth and ongoing promised recipients.
Truth as eventual fulfillment binds the promise to realization without making the recipient its scheduler.
The appointment dimension exposes timing as the pressure point in a parallel skeptical challenge.

structural_cues: 46:17 grounds denial in elapsed generations while the parents answer that the divine promise is true.
46:18 follows with the word becoming due over prior communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a true-promise formula and a second challenge driven by elapsed time. I infer that the focus demand smuggles in an immediacy criterion and that delay does not reverse the promise-to-fulfillment arrow. A live alternative is that the two promises concern different horizons and only loosely illuminate one another.

changed_reading.before: If the threat does not arrive now, the speaker is not truthful.
changed_reading.after: The challenge confuses control of appointment with truth of fulfillment; delay belongs to the promise's horizon, not to its falsity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate reply assigns knowledge to God and the messenger only the delivery of what he was sent with. The focus imperative therefore tests the wrong agency: it asks the carrier of a warning to act as controller of the warned event.

activation_trace.role: The focus imperative assigns production and presentation of the event to the addressed messenger.
Knowledge disclosed to its knower is located with God, limiting the messenger's temporal authority.
Conveying a message defines the messenger's positive function as transmission rather than event production.
Messenger and message supply the delegated relation within which the warning reaches the people.

structural_cues: 46:21 supplies the warning, 46:22 demands its arrival, and 46:23 immediately answers by separating knowledge from conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacency and explicit role statements. I infer a blocked arrow from conveying a warning to controlling its occurrence: delivery of message does not entail command of event. A live alternative is that the demand is knowingly mocking and never intended as a serious claim about messenger agency.

changed_reading.before: They ask the messenger to prove himself by producing the threatened event.
changed_reading.after: Their proposed proof is malformed because it makes delegated conveyance answer for sovereign knowledge and execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: What they hastened is then seen approaching as a horizon-bearing formation and named as rain for them, but it is corrected to a wind carrying painful punishment and executing destruction by command. The demanded delivery does arrive; their failure shifts from lack of evidence to misclassification of the evidence as benefit.

activation_trace.role: The focus makes arrival of calamity the very delivery demanded as proof.
Water descending from cloud supplies the beneficial reading the observers assign to the approaching sign.
Hastening identifies the approaching event as the same fulfillment they had pressed to be advanced.
Wind replaces the expected rain as the actual material carrier of the warning.
Comprehensive ruin supplies the realized outcome that verifies the threat after the perceptual mistake.
Authoritative command locates execution beyond the messenger whose truth they challenged.

structural_cues: 46:24 moves through seeing, naming, correction, and disclosed content before 46:25 states the result.
The correction explicitly identifies the apparition as what they sought to hasten.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit haste-link, the rain reading, its correction to wind and punishment, and the destruction. I infer that this sequence answers the focus imperative and turns the proof problem into a recognition problem. A live alternative is to keep the historical storm answer separate from the broader truth condition in the focus.

changed_reading.before: They assume a genuine warning would be unmistakably delivered as punishment on demand.
changed_reading.after: The requested event approaches under a form they welcome, so fulfillment exposes not missing proof but their confidence in reading appearances.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once the mocked threat encloses them, the gods adopted as means of nearness do not help and instead go missing from them. This reverses the focus's directional accusation: the messenger does not have to turn the people away from their gods; at the demanded test, the gods are absent from the people.

activation_trace.role: The possessive objects of worship are the relationship the speakers present as threatened.
Directional deflection supplies the relation whose agent and object will be ironically reversed.
Descending harm that surrounds them establishes the moment when protective relations are tested.
Aid that should make a protector effective is explicitly absent at the crisis.
Cultic nearness explains the relational purpose for which the gods had been adopted.
The same worship-object category identifies the supposed helpers that disappear.
A lie displaced from truth names the cultic construction after its failure.

structural_cues: 46:28 asks why the adopted gods did not help, then answers that they went missing from their worshippers.
The focus preposition marks movement away from the gods; 46:28 marks the gods' absence from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed aid, adopted nearness, disappearance, and the repeated worship and deflection roots. I infer an ironic reversal in who is separated from whom. A live alternative is that disappearance only denies the gods' reality and should not be personified as their withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: They defend stable gods from a messenger who would separate worshippers from them.
changed_reading.after: The demanded crisis reveals the relation's instability: the supposed near protectors cannot help and are the ones absent from their worshippers.

context_deltas.mechanism: A group is redirected toward the messenger, listens, and returns as warners; the ensuing appeal is to answer the divine caller, while refusal yields neither escape nor protecting allies. This supplies a counter-model to the focus accusation: directional change can open hearing and responsive agency rather than merely erase an inherited orientation.

activation_trace.role: The focus treats being turned from a prior direction as the messenger's hostile purpose.
Redirection toward the messenger supplies a contrasting directional movement that leads into listening.
Answering speech makes the desired result of redirection an active response rather than passive displacement.
A verbal call that inclines its hearer supplies the non-coercive social mechanism of invitation.
Failure to evade pursuit gives refusal a consequence without making hearing itself coercion.
Unavailable protective alliance answers the focus attachment to gods as presumed relational support.

structural_cues: 46:29 orders redirection, listening, return, and warning as a causal-looking sequence.
46:31-32 contrast answering the caller with refusal and lack of protectors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redirection toward the messenger, listening, answering, and the consequence of non-answer. I infer a contrast between manipulative diversion and orientation that enables response. A live alternative is that divine redirection and the human persuasion alleged in the focus are different agencies and should only be compared analogically.

changed_reading.before: Any movement away from inherited gods is represented as loss imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: The later receptive group shows redirection as an opening of attention that can issue in its own speech, warning, and chosen response.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the final presentation, the question of truth is put to the rejecters, they affirm it, and experience follows; the messenger is separately told not to hasten the promise for them. The focus test is thus inverted in speaker, timing, and mode of proof: those who demanded delivery become the witnesses and tasters once the event is no longer theirs to schedule.

activation_trace.role: The focus makes realized action the challengers' criterion for the messenger's truth.
The focus pressure on the promised event carries an implicit demand to control its appointment.
Reality matching truth becomes the question they themselves must answer once confronted with the event.
Direct experience replaces their earlier demand for an externally staged demonstration.
The prohibition on advancing events explicitly denies the timetable demanded in the focus.
The promised appointment remains fixed until it is seen rather than summoned by challengers.
Perceived delay collapses to a brief interval once the promise is visible, reversing the challengers' temporal confidence.

structural_cues: 46:22 has the rejecters question the messenger's truth; 46:34 has truth questioned of the rejecters and affirmed by them.
46:35 directly joins non-hastening, sight of what was promised, and an interval felt as only an hour of a day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed question-answer scene, experiential consequence, non-hastening, and compressed remembered duration. I infer that the focus verification demand returns upon its speakers with agency and timing reversed. A live alternative is that 46:34-35 operates on a final eschatological horizon distinct from the historical storm that first answers 46:22.

changed_reading.before: They are examiners who can require the messenger to prove truth by immediate delivery.
changed_reading.after: They become examined witnesses who concede truth only when delivery has become unavoidable experience, at a time they did not control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material water and weather branches that are not the local dictionary senses required by the focus syntax. It remains anchored in three focus roots and becomes unusually coherent when the demanded event appears as expected rain but arrives as wind. Downstream prose should present it only as latent hydrological resonance, not as a replacement translation or an etymological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence of coming, turning away, and commanding the promised thing to come.

activation_trace.role: A low place collecting water gives the messenger's coming a latent receiving-basin image.
Land from which rain is withheld materializes deflection as deprivation of expected water.
A flood arriving from a rained-on region makes the command to bring the warning resonate as incoming weather from elsewhere.
Expected rainfall activates the beneficial side of the focus's latent water sequence.
The disclosed wind reverses the anticipated water-bearing arrival into the material carrier of harm.

changed_reading.before: The focus uses only social redirection and a verbal demand for punishment.
changed_reading.after: A contained material echo runs beneath it: withheld rain, incoming water, and a receiving place culminate in a horizon sign misread as rain but delivered as wind.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped inventories for the promise root rather than the ordinary promise branch. It remains valid as an activation because the focus makes timing the test and 46:35 joins the same root to non-hastening, an hour, and daylight. Downstream prose should label it a counting-and-cycle resonance, never a lexical disambiguation of the surface verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The demanded fulfillment of what is promised and the conditional claim to truthfulness.

activation_trace.role: Counting makes the challengers' demand resonate as a request that the warning become presently reckonable.
A counted interval supplies the latent deadline they impose on truth.
The annual cycle broadens that deadline into recurring measured time.
A time-counter and recurrence reconnect the promised event to measured duration at the point it is seen.
Delay and slowness supply the duration whose apparent scale later collapses.
Daylight opening bounds the final comparison in a concrete daily cycle.

changed_reading.before: They merely demand that the promised event occur soon.
changed_reading.after: Their taunt tries to put truth on a countable clock, while the later view of fulfillment makes the supposedly long interval contract to a fragment of one daylight cycle.

strongest_changes: The focus dare echoes 46:4's proof formula but substitutes catastrophe for documentary or knowledge-bearing evidence.
46:23 separates conveying the warning from knowing or controlling its occurrence, exposing a category error in the demanded proof.
46:24-25 answers the haste with an approaching sign welcomed as rain and disclosed as destructive wind.
46:28 and 46:34 reverse the challengers' assumptions: their gods are absent at the test, and they become the ones compelled to affirm the truth.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates directional change, arrival, promise, and truth in one adversarial exchange. Context repeatedly changes who turns whom, who can bring what, who controls timing, and who finally testifies; the packet's material and split-root branches also preserve contained weather and counting resonances that a consensus reading would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The echo of 46:4 may be deliberate counter-rhetoric or simply a recurring challenge formula.
The contrast between hostile deflection and receptive redirection is mechanistically strong but crosses different agents and roots.
The historical storm and the final presentation may be layered answers to the same demand or distinct fulfillment horizons.
The hydrological and counted-time outliers are inspectable activations, not claims about the primary lexical senses.
